body:
Tested locally (rebased on top of `master` https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/39c201ca58a8ddf1e99e62c8453294a2662a2fd8), I get an issue in 2D. The [2D platformer demo](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-demo-projects/tree/master/2d/platformer) freezes when opened in the editor after the "restoring scene layout" popup is done running. This seems to occur with every 2D project I've tried.

In comparison, it works in a 3D project like [Truck Town](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-demo-projects/tree/master/2d/truck_town) and [Platformer](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-demo-projects/tree/master/3d/platformer):

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b7937f87-99e2-4ecc-aeb0-3970ecbd4374)

Note that `player.tscn` is very small in the 3D platformer demo because the Decal node's AABB is taken into account. (The decal is used for a blob shadow.) Decal nodes' AABBs should probably be excluded if possible, as we only care about the surface the decal is being projected on for the preview, not the decal itself.

This PR also gets rid of the progress dialog that appears when saving a scene:

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/763a8332-6041-4fc5-a6bd-b198ca3bf6dd)

I consider this to be a good change for scenes that save in less than 1 second – this should also help resolve https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/78753. However, for scenes that take a while to save, we should have some kind of progress dialog back (or at least a visible notice somewhere in the editor). You can create a scene that takes a while to save by adding a VoxelGI node, setting it to 512 subdivisions, baking it and choosing **Make Unique** on the VoxelGI node's **Data** property.

Additionally, you could do the same as https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/97468 to improve preview quality using MSAA and SSAA together. This should only increase the GPU requirements minimally since the previews are low-resolution. To cater for 2D previews, also enable 2D MSAA when relevant, not just 3D MSAA.

For a future PR, we can also further improve the preview by adding a checkered floor below the object and enabling shadows on the DirectionalLight3D. This way, you get a sense of the object's scale.

The 2D platformer demo no longer freezes on opening. It still got stuck for a while while generating previews, but I couldn't reproduce this a second time, even after removing `$HOME/.cache/godot/` and `.godot/` in the project folder.

Also, messages about 2D MSAA not being supported in GLES3 are spammed when the editor is open. To fix this, wrap the call that sets 2D MSAA with this:

```cpp
if (RS::get_singleton()->get_current_rendering_method_name() != "gl_compatibility") {
    ...
}
```

Lastly, the default canvas texture filter project setting is not applied when generating previews, which means sprites always use linear filtering. This can cause them to look blurry in the preview:

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c5f33db8-d886-4d64-90c5-2ddb6e409a5c)

To fix this, set the default canvas texture filter and repeat settings on the SubViewport used for thumbnail rendering according to the project settings `rendering/textures/canvas_textures/default_texture_filter` and `rendering/textures/canvas_textures/default_texture_repeat`.

Functionality-wise it looks good now.
The implementation seems fine in general, but I did not review too deeply. There is some usage of mutexes and rendering API that might need extra checking.

Tested locally, it works as expected. Code looks good to me.
